scripts.kill-client-port: npx kill-port 5173 || echo Port 5173 cleared & npx kill-port 5174 || echo Port 5174 cleared
scripts.dev: npm run kill-port && cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run mongod" "npm run client" "npm run server"
scripts.start: npm run kill-port && npm run kill-client-port && concurrently "npm run mongod" "npm run client" "npm run server"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
